causality_note: Funding timestamps are a deterministic UTC 00/08/16 schedule (funding_interval_hours=8), known in advance like a calendar; checking whether a funding open_time falls in (signal_time, signal_time+K*5min] at decision time uses NO market future and is NOT leakage. Filter decision is frozen per branch before any backtest.
control: K=0/1x normal must reproduce published isotonic_4 exposure1.0 (+122.80% total_return, -20.09% max_drawdown, 65 trades) or STOP
dd_guard_reference: K=0 control (k0_1x) sampled equity (trade exit_time/equity_after, trade-candle-close sampled), past-only 1-microsecond cutoff, 100.0 seed level; each branch applies the guard state at its OWN (filtered) signal times. Shared-reference design per v11/v17, disclosed.
execution_frozen: entry_expiry_bars=12 (base from dataset config), max_holding_bars=2016 (7d*288), tp1_fraction=0.5, intrabar_policy=stop_first; ONLY the signal subset varies by K
family: R4-N4 neutral: funding-timestamp avoidance filter on frozen v30 isotonic-4 x {1x, dd_guard}
filter_rule: For K>0: drop a LONG signal iff any funding_flags() candle (open_time with hour%8==0 & min==0 & sec==0) has bar_index in [signal_bar_index+1, signal_bar_index+K], equivalently a funding open_time in (signal_time, signal_time+K*5min]. K=0 keeps all (control). SHORT signals always kept (short funding is zero by assumption). Entry/holding/costs identical across branches.
frozen: identical frozen 94-signal base set (60 long / 34 short); scores never refit; no threshold/expiry/geometry change; ONLY the K-filtered subset varies

funding.note: longs pay 0.0001 per 8h funding timestamp while in position; shorts pay zero by user assumption

hypothesis: Longs pay 0.0001/8h funding while in position; a long opened just before a funding timestamp pays almost immediately with no time to earn it back. Skipping long entries in the 30 min (K=6 bars) or 60 min (K=12 bars) before a funding timestamp should save funding drag at the cost of fewer longs. SHORT signals always kept. Exploratory only.
